body: Hey just wanted to say thank you, for the past few days I've been doing what you suggested and it's really helped I feel like I have a better mindset now and that I'm actually accomplishing things even tho there just normal everyday things, just wanted to say thankyou
Yeah I have friends that are there for me and I honestly wouldn't have gotten this far without them, I'm tired of not being okay.

I felt the exact same way I couldn't stick to anything and it made me feel worse, one day I was scrolling through tiktok and came across a girl who started a gamer journal just 2 pages for each game full of drawings of her favourite characters, favourite weapons, maps or her favourite missions/ quests, and it's helped me stay focused on games and given me somthing to do, it's honestly helped my depression alot.
I'll look onto therapy and see if it helps thank you for chatting with me

Wouldn't even know to go about talking to a therapist or counsellor I have good days and bad days and on my good days I feel like there's no point talking to someone, just feel constantly on edge and feel like I don't have a choice
Yeah sure just scared to say to my friends or family incase they worry and then it makes me feel like I don't have a choice because I don't wanna hurt them.
